name: Jeshua
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: The chief of the Levites, Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua, gave thanks according to the commandment of David, ward over against ward. This is the book of the chronicles, our ancestors written down in the record.

note.label: Nehemiah 12: The Priests, the Levites, and the Dedication of the Wall
